acceptance: `generate --vendor` writes the four-sheet vendor-only sample with only that vendor's rows, only released questions and only vendor-visible columns, due dates from working days, and the vendor-editable columns shaded. (B1, B2, B3, B4, B5)
The file is accepted by the Vendor Workbook Updater's reader and input rules. (B6)
The same data and as-of date give files that match cell for cell, and an unknown vendor, invalid data or a secret-like value stops with the problem named and no file written. (B7, B8)
